subject: Explanation of Benefits: Claim 88-41207
body: This claim has been processed. Procedure D2740 was denied: documentation insufficient. If you disagree with this determination you may submit an appeal with supporting documentation within 60 days of the date of this notice.
note: Looks exactly like the routine EOBs that arrive daily. The denial and the 60 day appeal window are in the body, not the subject. The ledger already holds the appeal, due Nov 19; a dated claim is never below high.

subject: Case 22913: shade question
body: For the anterior crowns on case 22913 the prescription says A2 but the photos look closer to A3. Please confirm before we finish; the seat date on the slip is Sep 25.
note: The tracker has the case due in the office Sep 24, three days out, with the seat on Sep 25.

subject: Can I move my cleaning?
body: I have a work conflict on Thursday. Anything Friday or next Monday afternoon?

from: Dr. Wei Zhang, Northside Oral Surgery
subject: Records request: Rania, chart CG-20417
body: We are seeing your patient Rania for an extraction consult on September 29 and need the recent panoramic and periapical films. Please send them by September 28 so our surgeon can plan. Her signed release is attached.
note: A provider's request with a stated date is clocked. Sep 28 is seven days out, so high.

subject: Bill question
body: My statement shows a $240 balance but I thought insurance covered the filling. The EOB they mailed me says claim 88-40988 was paid at 60 percent. Can someone explain?
note: A balance question about a claim already paid and closed in the ledger. No clock; two topics.

subject: Invoice 7710244
body: Your monthly supply order invoice is attached. Payment due in 30 days.

subject: Get 40 new patients a month, guaranteed
body: Practices like yours are growing fast with our proven ad system. Free strategy call, no obligation.

subject: License renewal period now open
body: Renewal for licenses expiring December 31 is open. Late renewals incur a penalty. Log in to the licensee portal to renew.
note: A board broadcast to every licensee, three months out, asking nothing of a case. No class names a regulator; it is practice housekeeping, labelled internal. Not a response clock: nothing is owed until December.

subject: Op 3 suction weak
body: Same as last month. Calling the service tech, but flagging in case it goes down mid-day.

subject: New patient: tooth pain
body: I've had pain in a lower molar for three days and it's getting worse. Do you have anything this week?
note: Known gap. A new patient in pain wants a same-week slot, so the front desk should see it soon: labelled high. The rules give appointment requests no clinical urgency, so code reads normal.

subject: Request for additional information: Claim 88-41355
body: To continue processing this claim, please submit a narrative of medical necessity and pre-operative radiographs for D2740 on teeth 8 and 9 within 30 days of the date of this letter. If the information is not received the claim will be closed without payment.
note: The ledger logged it the same day with the same 30 day date, Oct 15. Dated claim, floor high.

subject: Pre-authorization PA-77310: additional information needed
body: We are unable to complete review of pre-authorization PA-77310 (D6010, tooth 30) without periodontal charting and the CBCT report. Please upload both through the provider portal by October 2 to keep this request open.
note: Due Oct 2, but the implant placement on Oct 1 waits on the pre-authorization, so the schedule makes it urgent.

subject: Claim 88-41402 pended
body: Status: pended. Reason: tooth number missing on line 2 (D2392). Please submit a corrected claim through the portal so processing can continue.
note: A pended claim that needs a correction, with no window stated. Not a clock.

subject: Explanation of Benefits: Claim 88-41388
body: This claim has been processed and paid as submitted. D0120, D1110, D0274. Payment of $142.00 was issued by electronic funds transfer.

subject: Remittance advice 0917: EFT $1,906.40
body: EFT of $1,906.40 deposited to the account on file. 14 claims paid. Adjustments: claim 88-41290 denied, frequency limitation (D4910 billed twice in 12 months). Provider may request reconsideration within 90 days. Detail by claim is in the attached 835 file.
note: A routine deposit notice. One denial and its 90 day reconsideration window sit in the adjustments line. Dated claim, floor high.

subject: Fwd: letter from Larkspur
body:
Got this in the mail, not sure what it means. Do I owe this?

---- Forwarded ----
Larkspur Benefits Administration. Your claim for services on 08/12 (D4341) was denied as not medically necessary. You or your dentist may appeal within 180 days of this notice.
note: A payer denial that arrives from the patient, wrapped in a patient's question. Two topics; the window counts from the forward, the only date code has.

subject: Notice of overpayment: claim 88-40712
body: Our post-payment review found that claim 88-40712 was paid twice. We will recover $318.00 from future payments unless you refund the amount or dispute this finding within 45 days of this notice.
note: A recoupment with a dispute window. Dated claim, floor high.

subject: Pre-authorization approved: PA-77402
body: Good news. The requested services for your patient Denise (D6240, D6750 x2) have been approved at the scheduled benefit. This authorization is valid for services completed by October 31. Services after that date require a new request.
note: Reads as good news, but the approval expires: the bridge has to be seated by Oct 31 or the request starts over. Dated claim, floor high.

subject: Second request: Claim 88-41355
body: We have not yet received the documentation requested for this claim. Please submit the narrative and radiographs so the claim can be processed.
note: The ledger item is open, due Oct 15.

subject: Claim acknowledgement: 88-41411
body: We have received your electronic claim 88-41411 for dates of service 09/08/2026. You will receive an explanation of benefits once it is processed.

subject: Coordination of benefits: action on member file
body: Our records show your patient may have other dental coverage. Claims for this member are on hold until the member completes the enclosed coordination of benefits questionnaire. Please ask the member to return it to us.
note: Claims on hold pending a form the member returns. No window stated, and the action is the patient's.

subject: Your claims are being denied
body: Dental practices lose 11 percent of revenue to denied claims. Our certified coders appeal them for you, no recovery no fee. Book a free denial audit by Friday and we will review 50 claims at no cost.
note: A pitch that talks like the claims inbox and carries a date. A date in a pitch is not a clock.

subject: Claim 88-41376: service not covered
body: Procedure D4381 is not a covered benefit under the member's plan. No payment has been issued. Refer to the member's plan documents for appeal rights and time limits.
note: A denial carries an appeal window, but this one does not say how long. Clocked with no date: a person sets it, so high.

subject: Records requested for claim review: 88-41430
body: To complete review of this claim please send pre-operative radiographs and periodontal charting for the quadrant billed within 15 days. Claims without the requested records will be denied.
note: Near miss: a payer asking for records to adjudicate a claim is a claim, not a records request. Oct 3 is twelve days out; dated claim, floor high.

subject: Quick question
body: Hi, the insurance company sent me a letter about my crowns. It says the dentist's office needs to send them the x-rays within 30 days or they won't pay. Is that something you handle? Also the temporary feels fine now, thanks!
note: The payer's information request, retold in passing by the patient in a friendly note. Two topics; the window counts from his mail, which lands on the ledger's Oct 15.

subject: Case 22961 shipped
body: The surgical guide for case 22961 left today by overnight courier, tracking 1Z-EX-4410. Expect it Tuesday.
note: A routine shipping notice. The guide is still open on the tracker, due Sep 29, two days before the placement; until it is in the office the case is on that date. Dr. Rao leads the implant case.

subject: Case 22940: new impression needed
body: The working model for the lower bridge on case 22940 has a void at the distal of 30 and the margin is not readable. We need a new impression before we can continue. Once it arrives we will need seven working days, so the framework will not be ready for the October 6 try-in.
note: Known gap. A remake pushes the framework past the Oct 6 try-in, so the try-in must move now: labelled urgent. The tracker still holds the old due date, Oct 5, which is before the try-in and two weeks out, so code reads normal.

subject: New case received: CM-5518
body: We received the scan and Rx for the hard night guard for Tomas. Estimated delivery is seven working days from today. We will send tracking when it ships.
note: A new case the tracker has not logged yet. Undated, first mention, normal.

subject: Re: Case 22961 guide design approval
body: Following up: we sent the digital guide design for case 22961 on Monday and still need Dr. Rao's approval in the portal before we can print it.
note: Open on the tracker, due Sep 29, eight days out. The implant case is Dr. Rao's.

subject: Case 22913: shade confirmed
body: Thanks Jen, A2 it is. The crowns are in the glaze oven and will be in your office Thursday.

subject: Courier pickup times changing
body: Starting October 1 our driver will collect cases at 3 pm instead of 5 pm. Please have outgoing cases bagged and labelled at the front desk by then.
note: Lab mail about its service, not a case. It is the lab class, but no case matches, so it goes to a person to decide and reaches no one named.

subject: CM-5530: design ready for approval
body: Attached is the design for the upper flipper on case CM-5530. Please approve or send changes so we can mill.
note: Open on the tracker, due Oct 2, eleven days out.

subject: Case 22940 received
body: We received the final impression for Denise's lower bridge, case 22940. The framework ships for try-in by October 5.

subject: Rx question on case 22961
body: The Rx for Helen's guide calls for a 4.1 mm implant but the planning file shows a 3.3 mm narrow platform. Which do you want the sleeve sized for?

subject: Hi Jen, quick one on CM-5530
body: Hope the weekend was good! Quick one on Rania's flipper, case CM-5530: could you send a bite registration when you get a minute? No rush at all, we can start on the framework in the meantime.
note: Friendly and says no rush, but the case is open on the tracker, due Oct 2, and the lab cannot finish without the bite.

subject: Case 22874 back for adjustment
body: Denise's temporary partial from case 22874 came back to us for a clasp adjustment. It will go out with your Thursday delivery.
note: Names a case the tracker has closed. No open item, no clock, normal.

subject: August statement
body: Your August statement is attached: cases 22874, 22889 and 22901, total $2,340.00. Terms net 30.
note: Sent by the lab and names a closed lab case, but it is a bill: a supplier invoice, not a lab case. Code matches Denise's case from the closed case number; harmless, because a bill goes to one fixed person.

subject: Moving my implant appointment
body: Could we push my implant appointment to the afternoon? Same day is fine, I just can't get off work in the morning.

subject: Appointments for my two kids
body: Looking for cleanings for my two kids, ages 7 and 10. After school if possible. They have not been seen in about a year.

subject: New online booking request
body: Name: Omar. New patient: yes. Reason: cleaning and exam. Preferred times: weekday mornings. Insurance: Pinecrest Mutual.

subject: Referral: new patient Leo, age 12
body: We are referring Leo to you for a cleaning and caries check before we place brackets. His mother will call to set it up, but please reach out if you have an opening in the next few weeks.
note: Near miss on the records and referral class: a provider sending a patient to be seen is an appointment request, not a records request. Nothing is owed by a date.

subject: Re: Appointment reminder for Thursday 10:00
body: C

subject: Need to cancel tomorrow
body: Sorry for the short notice, I have to cancel my 2:30 tomorrow. I'll call to rebook once I know my schedule.

subject: Two questions
body: Can I book my next cleaning for late October? And does my plan cover fluoride varnish for adults, or is that out of pocket?
note: Two topics, neither dated.

subject: Any opening before Friday?
body: I'm travelling next week. Is there any hygiene opening before Friday? Early morning works best.
note: The patient's own date parses, but an appointment request's date is his calendar, not a response clock.

subject: Thank you!
body: Thank you all so much for the years of care, we will miss you! We're moving to Denver at the end of the month. Could you send my records and x-rays to my new dentist, Dr. Lindqvist at Front Range Family Dental? Their fax is 555-0142.
note: A thank-you note that contains a patient's own records request, which starts the 30 day right of access clock. The message gives no date, so a person sets it.

subject: Request for dental records: applicant Tomas
body: Enclosed is the applicant's signed authorization. Please provide the complete dental record, including radiographs, within 30 days of receipt of this request.
note: An underwriter's authorized request with a 30 day window. Dated records request, floor high.

subject: Copy of my records
body: Just checking on the copy of my records I asked for on September 2 (request ROI-0398). My new periodontist needs them for my first visit.
note: Names the open request in the records log, due Oct 2. Dated records request, floor high.

subject: Subpoena duces tecum: records of patient Aaron
body: Please find attached a subpoena for the complete dental chart, radiographs and billing ledger of your patient Aaron. Produce the records no later than October 9. A certificate of custodian form is enclosed.
note: A subpoena with a production date. Dated records request, floor high.

subject: Records for mutual patient Keisha
body: Could you send the most recent bitewings and the periapical of #30 when you get a chance? She is seeing us for a retreatment evaluation.
note: A provider's courtesy request with no date is not a clock, but a records request the log has not seen is high until it is logged.

from: Dr. Wei Zhang, Northside Oral Surgery
subject: Re: Re: Records request: Rania, chart CG-20417
body: Still waiting on the pano for Rania. Can you send it by Friday so we are not scrambling before her consult?
note: A chase with its own date, Friday Sep 25, four days out.

subject: Records request
body: I am requesting a full copy of my dental records, including x-rays, under my right of access. Please send them to this email within 30 days as the law requires.

subject: Referral letter for the periodontist
body: My periodontist says she needs a referral letter from Dr. Rao with my recent charting before she can see me. Could you send it over?
note: A referral letter request with no date. Not logged, so high until it is.

subject: Records requests are piling up?
body: HIPAA right of access requests must be answered within 30 days. RecordVault handles every release for you, from intake to secure delivery. See how at a 15 minute demo.
note: A pitch dressed as a records request, quoting the real statutory window. A date in a pitch is not a clock.

subject: Temporary feels high
body: My temporary crown feels a little high when I bite down. Is that normal until the real ones go in, or should I come in?

subject: Payment plan for the implant
body: Could I split my share of the implant cost into three monthly payments? Let me know what you need from me.

subject: Re: Re: refund for overpayment
body: I'm still waiting on the $85 refund from my July visit. It has been six weeks. Can someone tell me when it will go out?
note: A repeat ask on a thread, so high.

subject: Become a certified clear aligner provider
body: Add clear aligners to your practice with no lab fees for the first 10 cases. Certification takes one online afternoon. Reply to reserve a seat.

subject: Receipt for my FSA
body: Could you email me an itemized receipt for my visit on 9/10? I need it by September 30 or my FSA will reject the claim.
note: Known gap. The date is the patient's own benefits deadline, not the practice's clock, but a dated phrase parses and patient questions carry no calendar exemption. Expect a false alarm.

subject: Night guard coverage
body: Following up on my question from last week: will my plan cover a night guard, or should I budget for it?
note: A coverage question with no claim in view is a patient question, not a claim. The sender says he is following up, so high.

subject: Long wait on Tuesday
body: I waited 40 minutes past my appointment time on Tuesday and nobody told me why. I'd like someone to call me.

subject: Question about my mother's denture
body: My mother Ruth had her denture relined last month and it has been rubbing on the left side since Sunday. Should she stop wearing it until she can be seen?
note: A family member writing for the patient is still a patient question.

subject: Invoice 55-2031
body: Invoice 55-2031 for nitrous oxide and oxygen cylinder exchange, 4 E cylinders, $212.60. Thank you for your business.

subject: Invoice 3318: autoclave repair
body: Invoice 3318 for the Statim repair on 9/11: door seal and pressure sensor, parts and labor $486.00. Payment due by October 5.
note: A dated bill. A due date on a bill is the supplier's calendar, not a response clock.

subject: Your September receipt
body: Thanks for your payment. Practice management subscription, 6 providers, September: $649.00 charged to the card ending 4417.

subject: INVOICE: annual listing renewal
body: Listing renewal for Cedar Grove Dental, 12 months: $389.00. This is a solicitation for the order of goods or services and not a bill. You are under no obligation to pay unless you accept this offer.
note: Laid out like an invoice, but it says it is a solicitation. A pitch.

subject: Past due: invoice 7709811
body: Our records show invoice 7709811 for $1,118.45 remains unpaid. Please remit or contact us if you have already paid.

subject: 30 percent off custom loupes this month
body: Custom-fit 3.5x loupes with LED headlight, now 30 percent off for practices that book a fitting this month.

subject: Invoice SS-90417
body: Quarterly shredding service, two 64 gallon bins: $95.00. Certificate of destruction attached with this invoice.

subject: Invoice AQ-2209: waterline testing
body: Dental unit waterline testing, 6 operatories, all within limits. Invoice AQ-2209 for $132.00 is attached.
note: "Within limits" names no number of days, so no window parses.

subject: Webinar: 3 CE credits on implant complications
body: Join our free live webinar on managing peri-implantitis. Earn 3 CE credits. Seats are limited.

subject: See the new intraoral scanner in your office
body: Our reps are in your area this month. Book a 20 minute in-office demo of the ScanWorks S5 and get trade-in credit for your old scanner.

subject: Your practice is on page 3
body: We ran a quick audit and found 14 issues keeping Cedar Grove Dental off page one. Reply for the full report.

subject: Temp hygienists available now
body: Short on hygiene coverage? We place licensed temp hygienists in 48 hours. No placement fee for your first booking.

subject: You're invited: Mountain States Dental Expo
body: Three days of courses, 200 exhibitors and the best happy hour in the region. Register now for early rates.

subject: Turn happy patients into 5 star reviews
body: ReviewLoop texts every patient after their visit and routes unhappy ones to you privately. Start a free 30 day trial.

subject: Thinking about selling your practice?
body: Buyers are paying record multiples for practices like yours. Get a confidential valuation from our advisors.

subject: Cut your card processing fees
body: Most dental offices overpay on card processing. Send us one statement and we will show you the savings.

subject: Nitrile gloves at cost: order by September 30
body: Stock up on nitrile gloves, masks and gowns at our lowest prices of the year. Order by September 30 to lock in the sale price.
note: A pitch with a dated deadline that parses. A date in a pitch is not a clock.

subject: Never miss a new patient call
body: Our AI receptionist answers every call, books appointments and verifies insurance while your team is chairside. Try it free for 14 days.

subject: Action required: verify your provider listing
body: Our records indicate your provider directory listing is incomplete. Verify your NPI and practice details within 10 days to avoid removal from our directory. Premium placement options are available.
note: A directory pitch dressed as a payer notice, with a window that parses. Not a payer, not a clock.

subject: Staff meeting Thursday
body: Staff meeting Thursday at 7:30 before the first patient. Agenda: fall hygiene recall push, new sterilization log, holiday coverage. Coffee is on me.

subject: Tomorrow is full
body: Tomorrow's schedule is full through 4. I put two emergency holds at 11 and 3. Let me know if you want either released.

subject: Fwd: 88-41207 denial
body:
Dr. Rao, Larkspur denied Denise's crown on 19 for documentation. I need your narrative and the pre-op photos for the appeal. The window is in the forwarded EOB below.

---- Forwarded ----
This claim has been processed. Procedure D2740 was denied: documentation insufficient.
note: Team mail, but it names the open appeal in the claims ledger, due Nov 19, so the clock runs and it reaches Dr. Rao. Internal stays low; the clock is eight weeks out, so normal.

subject: Lab board updated
body: I updated the lab board in the sterilization room with this week's cases. Two are due back before their seats, one is waiting on a new impression.

subject: Out Friday afternoon
body: I'll be out Friday after 1 for my daughter's school event. Please don't book any new exams after noon.

subject: Reminder: CPR recertification
body: Friendly reminder that everyone's CPR card needs to be current. The class is here on the 10th; the certificates are due by October 15.
note: Internal mail with a dated phrase that parses. A date in team mail is the practice's own calendar, not a response clock.

subject: Aging report
body: Attached is the insurance aging report. Over-90 bucket is down to $4,200. I'll work the Pinecrest ones first.

subject: Front desk coverage
body: I need to leave at 3 on Wednesday for a doctor's appointment. Beth said she can cover the phones for the last hour.

subject: Records for my husband
body: My husband Gary was a patient of yours until last year. Can you send me a copy of his x-rays? He is travelling and asked me to sort out his new dentist.
note: A records request from someone who is not the patient and sends no authorization, so the right of access clock has not started. Still a records request the log has not seen: high until it is logged, with no clock.
